Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for interviewing with the infra team yesterday. As discussed, please find the small take-home that helps us evaluate end-to-end reasoning about inference routing and cost/latency tradeoffs. A few quick notes: 

- The exercise should take ~3–4 hours; we don’t expect a polished production repo. Focus on clarity, assumptions, and a short README describing how you tested.
- Deadline: Tuesday, Dec 12, 11:59pm PST (one week). If you need an accommodation, tell us your preferred timeline and we can discuss.
- Submission: ZIP or link to a GitHub repo; please include a short writeup (max 750 words) summarizing findings and tradeoffs.

Attachment: assignment_v2.pdf (PDF, 48KB) — contains prompt, dataset sketch, and rubric summary.

If anything in the prompt is unclear, reply here; we’ll do a brief clarifying note rather than rework the task. Good luck — looking forward to your submission.
